batch_status.notes:
PAGE 31 THIRD CHANT IS DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN. Chant 15, the Paticcasamuppada-patho, opens at the foot of page 31 as justified prose under a sub-heading and runs onto page 32. It is already in the app with 24 verses covering both vara, and page 31 prints only the first twelve. Giving it page_start 31 without reading page 32 would place all 24 verses on page 31 — twice what the book prints there — and a page number may never be inferred. Page 32 must be read first, which is why resume_from_page is 32.

SECOND FINDING, and it needs Josh. The app Paticcasamuppada prints the sense-bases word with a pho at verses 4, 5, 16 and 17, and the photograph appears to agree. Standard Pali is salayatana, with a lo chula. This is the same lo-chula/pho hazard proven twice on pages 22 and 23: this typeface renders lo chula so that it photographs as pho, so the photograph CANNOT settle it, and the instruction to let the photo win must NOT be applied here — doing so would fix four wrong readings in place. Left untouched pending the physical book.

THIRD: the Pabbatopama `source` field in the app cited page 30 two footnotes, which belong to the two chants above it. Its real citation is page 31 footnote 1. The pasted text had run the pages together. Worth suspecting wherever a pre-page chant carries a `source` naming more than one reference.

FOURTH: Adiyasutta is a genuinely new chant, not one of the seventeen. It brings the app to 49.
